bug_semantics: The attribute-view (database) Template calculation feature introduced in v3.7.0-beta.1 (rollup/footer template calculations in kernel/av/calc_template.go) renders user-supplied template formulas through text/template with an UNMODIFIED `sprig.TxtFuncMap()`. Sprig's map still exposes `env`, `expandenv`, and `getHostByName` — the same functions siyuan had already deleted from its document-template engine (filesys.BuiltInTemplateFuncs, after CVE-2024-55660 / issue #13426) and from SQL templates. A local, unauthenticated attacker (kernel binds 127.0.0.1 by default, no per-UID access control) injects a Template calculation formula like `.action{env "AWS_SECRET"}` to read environment variables of the siyuan process — including material belonging to other, unprivileged OS accounts visible in the process environment — and `.action{getHostByName ...}` to perform DNS lookups from the server's network position (CWE-200 Exposure of Sensitive Information).
flaw_origin: Commit fbda8db9d88bcdb0183515195d754a39dc5b707f ("Database rollup fields now support additional calculation methods" #14394, 2026-06-17, author+committer Daniel <845765@qq.com>) created kernel/av/calc_template.go with `goTpl := template.New("").Delims(".action{", "}").Funcs(sprig.TxtFuncMap())` — wiring raw Sprig into the calculation engine with no deletion of env/expandenv/getHostByName, unlike the hardened filesys.BuiltInTemplateFuncs() used by kernel/model/template.go since 2024. Parent e2a9f03604 has no calc_template.go (introducer_parent_absent=true). The sibling commit 669c95861576 (same day, same issue #14394) extended the same template machinery to footer calculations but did not create the unsafe FuncMap wiring. Both are parts of the #14394 template-calculation feature whose first shipped form (v3.7.0-beta.1) is the BIC window the advisory names.
ai_marker: absent — the BIC commit object names author and committer Daniel <845765@qq.com> (2026-06-17), human feature message with Signed-off-by; no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, or bot/AI identity anywhere on the object.
evidence: Advisory (CVE-2026-73047 / GHSA-qgh7-j4r2-h63j, upstream advisory GHSA-v97v-gxxg-rhmq, VulnCheck): siyuan <= 3.7.3 (fixed v3.7.4) — attribute-view Template calculation (introduced v3.7.0-beta.1) uses Sprig's unmodified function map exposing env/expandenv/getHostByName that were removed elsewhere for CVE-2024-55660; local unauthenticated attacker reads process environment variables (including other unprivileged accounts') and performs DNS lookups; CWE-200.

BIC creation check: fbda8db9d88b (2026-06-17) creates kernel/av/calc_template.go with `goTpl := template.New("").Delims(".action{", "}").Funcs(sprig.TxtFuncMap())` — the only template engine in the repo wired to raw Sprig; kernel/model/template.go and SQLTemplateFuncs use filesys.BuiltInTemplateFuncs(), which since 2024 (issue #13426, CVE-2024-55660 wave) does `delete(ret, "env"); delete(ret, "expandenv"); delete(ret, "getHostByName")` (verified at v3.7.3:kernel/filesys/template.go lines 38-41).

Fix commit 36c297bd656f (2026-08-01, Daniel, GHSA-v97v-gxxg-rhmq — the advisory's own reference): adds to the calc template path `delete(tplFuncs, "env"); delete(tplFuncs, "expandenv"); delete(tplFuncs, "getHostByName")` with comment '与 filesys.BuiltInTemplateFuncs 保持一致' (keep consistent with BuiltInTemplateFuncs); 6 added lines in kernel/av/calc_template.go; first tagged v3.7.4-alpha.5 → v3.7.4, matching the advisory's fixed-in v3.7.4.
Version boundary: BIC first tagged v3.7.0-beta.1 → v3.7.0 (tag --contains head), exactly the advisory's 'introduced in v3.7.0-beta.1'; vulnerable through v3.7.3.

Decomposition: 669c95861576 (2026-06-17, same issue #14394) extends template calculations to database footer fields, reusing evalRollupTemplate/rollup machinery — recorded as the second wave of the same feature; the unsafe Sprig wiring originates in fbda8db9.

AI-marker screening: `git log --format='%an <%ae>%n%cn <%ce>%n%B' -1` on fbda8db9 and 669c9586 shows only Daniel with Signed-off-by trailers; grep for claude/copilot/anthropic/openai/generated/co-authored finds none; fix commit 36c297bd likewise plain human.
reasoning: Vulnerability first: the advisory names Sprig's unmodified function map exposing env/expandenv/getHostByName in the attribute-view template feature; the BIC's `.Funcs(sprig.TxtFuncMap())` with no deletions is exactly that, and the fix's three delete() calls with the 'keep consistent with BuiltInTemplateFuncs' comment prove the missing hardening is the defect. BIC choice: the unsafe engine wiring originates with the feature creation fbda8db9 (2026-06-17, first tagged v3.7.0-beta.1 — the advisory's own introduction boundary); the footer-extension commit 669c9586 is the feature's second wave (decomposed_shas). Squash check: both commits are feature-PR squashes for issue #14394; the flaw is the feature design (raw Sprig) rather than a security fix decomposed into a squash, so squash_decomposed=true marking the multi-commit feature. AI decision: BIC-only attribution — the BIC object carries only the human maintainer Daniel with no AI marker, so NOT_AI.
